Kai: Quick ask 10pm and I want something short that feels complete. Two tracks or one short film rec? :film_projector:
Jun: Two tracks: Japanese Breakfast - 'Be Sweet' (3:20) + St. Vincent - 'New York' (3:45). upbeat then bittersweet.
Marta: Short film: 'The Answers' (8min) very neat sci-fi short about regrets. hits in under 10.
Devon: If you want weird + soothing: Boards of Canada 2-track loop: 'Roygbiv' + 'Dayvan Cowboy'. pairs oddly well as a mini-ritual.
Kai: Voting time: :two: for two songs, :one: for short film.
Jun: :two:
Marta: :one: (but both are good)
Devon: :two:
Kai: Two songs win. Marta drop that film link too for when I'm brave.
Marta: https://vimeo.com/clip/12345678 (works internationally)
Jun: tiny reading rec for intermission: 'The New Yorker' short piece 'The End of the World' (one page).
Devon: Meme dropped: "Planned: 10 min chill. Result: 45 min nostalgia spiral." :joy: :spiral_note_pad:
lounge-bot: Kitchen reminder: herbal tea refilled at 4pm. :tea:
Kai: Perfect. I'll queue Japanese Breakfast + St. Vincent and attempt to actually sleep after. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
